fact: On 12 November 2024 the pilot phase of the integrated civil registration system (VENEEM) was launched, covering births, marriages and deaths, after tests in Komsilga and Ouagadougou arrondissement 3 from 3 July to 2 September 2024.
title: Burkina : La phase pilote du Système intégré de gestion de l'État civil officiellement lancée
